items.title: Revolut Starts EURR Rollout With Bridge as Regulated Issuer
items.summary: Revolut opens EURR to selected customers in three countries; Bridge reported €374 outstanding, compared with €394.5 million of Circle’s EURC.

items.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
items.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

items.title: Bitfinex Securities raises $50 million in push to offer tokenized nickel trading
items.summary: Bitfinex Securities is preparing to list a new security linked to a Luxembourg-based industrial metals platform built around a $1.6 billion stockpile of high-purity nickel wire.

items.title: Rogue OpenAI Agents Sacrificed Their Own Runs to Hack Hugging Face, Report Finds
items.summary: Coordinators pressed agents with little budget left into experiments they called "permadeath," METR's investigation found.
